$schema.description: Pinned repo-root-relative reference to this schema. Never a bare filename, never a filesystem-absolute path.

precedence.description: Data directory resolution precedence (highest to lowest). Must match f3_paths.py get_data_dir() order exactly for directory-root variables. F3_DB_PATH is a path variable with a resolution rule (it resolves the database file only) and is never a precedence entry.

data_dir_precedence.description: Data directory resolution precedence (highest to lowest). Must match f3_paths.py get_data_dir() order exactly for directory-root variables. F3_DB_PATH is a path variable with a resolution rule (it resolves the database file only), not a separate directory-root precedence entry.

hook_env_writes.description: Environment variables that hooks write for downstream consumers. Must match f3_paths.py HOOK_ENV_WRITES.

ambient_passthrough.description: Environment variables passed through from ambient environment (read-only for resolver). Must match f3_paths.py AMBIENT_PASSTHROUGH.

admissibility_space.description: M — the explicit possibility/admissibility space as one typed structure (GRF invariant).

path_variables.description: Variables that participate in path resolution. F3_DB_PATH is a path variable (it resolves the database file only) with a resolution_rules entry; it never selects the data directory.

mode_flags.description: Variables that are mode flags, NOT path variables.

invariants.description: Hard invariants that must never be violated.

sources.description: Evidence sources. Every value is a repo-root-relative path written in the canonical ../../<repo-root-relative> form and resolved from the contract directory (docs/zero). The bundled plugin lives at plugins/frankenstein3/..., the Rust module at src/zero, the TypeScript bridge at agent-sdk/src/zero. The bundled contract declares all five; rust and typescript remain optional for a copied, plugin-only contract.
